summary: The resting book at entry separates winners from losers out-of-fit, but not through the expected channels (imbalance, spread, wall size, day regime — all null). The dominant signal is a structural, direction-aware geometry binary discovered via wall-NaN semantics: when the visible depth snapshot has NO levels behind the trade (entry at the trade-favorable extreme of the book — long filled below all visible depth / short above it), win rate is 35.1%/42.1% (2025/2026) and $/t is +64/+164, vs 22.0%/21.7% and -87/-98 when depth rests behind the entry; gaps of +13.1pp/+$151 (2025) and +20.4pp/+$262 (2026) pass both evidence criteria and replicate inside pre, gold ($-criterion; 2025 wr +7.0pp), B, B2, long and short. Every covered trade has depth on at least one side, so this is exactly the nearest-visible-liquidity side. Secondary confirmed effects: book BUILDING in the 5 min before fill (dep_thick_d5m >= 2025 medians/q75) adds +9-12pp in both years (pre and all slices, criterion a), and a thin gold-window book (dep_thick < 2025-gold q25) marks losers (+8.5pp/+15.4pp, +$105/+$232, with a 2026 thinner-book distribution-shift caveat). A weak (b)-only pass: absolute one-sidedness |support-resist| >= 2025 q75 adds ~$70-90/t both years. The naive 'far wall ahead is good' distance result is a composition artifact of the edge binary and dies under control. Screen artifacts: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-AI-trading-agents/7bd370b8-a98c-5f48-81e7-271dcca63b21/scratchpad/depth_screen.py and depth_screen_results.csv; feature semantics verified against /home/user/AI-trading-agents/scripts/depth_features.py (walls = max-size visible level per side, NaN = no visible rows on that side; snapshot at ts <= fill minute, no lookahead).
nulls: dep_spread: NULL — zero passes at any 2025 quantile in any slice; bid-ask spread at entry does not separate.

day-regime proxies (per-day median dep_thick and dep_spread mapped to trades): NULL — zero passes; thick-book vs thin-book DAYS do not separate winners from losers, the thickness effect is trade-moment (gold) only.

dep_imb (raw book imbalance): NULL — no wr passes; the gold $-passes (q25/q50/q75) have win-rate gaps of opposite sign across the two years (e.g. q25: +0.6pp 2025 vs -4.2pp 2026), i.e. outlier-mean-driven, not a real separation.

dep_imb_dir (imbalance signed WITH trade direction, the canonical 'book leaning with you' feature): NULL — never passes (a); scattered $-only passes flip slice (pre_B at q75 vs pre_B2 at q25) with sub-8pp wr gaps. Book leaning with the trade does NOT predict wins out-of-fit.

dep_imb_abs: NULL/unstable — passes in pre_B with + sign (+6.5pp/+13.9pp) but in pre_B2 with OPPOSITE sign (-9.5pp/-8.1pp, that one technically passes both criteria); a sign flip between adjacent pattern slices with no mechanism = not reportable as a finding.

dep_sup_m_res (signed support-minus-resist) and dep_supres_dir (signed by trade direction): NULL — zero passes across 31 tested combos. Direction-signed depth asymmetry carries nothing; only its absolute value (finding 6) weakly does.

dep_support / dep_resist / dep_behind / dep_ahead (side totals, raw and direction-aware): NULL as independent signals — only passes are gold-q25 splits that duplicate the dep_thick gold finding (components of total size); no signal elsewhere.

dep_wall_ahead_d / dep_wall_above_d / dep_wall_below_d as DISTANCES among detected walls: NULL after control — the raw q75 'far wall ahead = good' passes (all: +8.6pp/+11.5pp) are a composition artifact of finding 1: when both sides have depth the ahead wall is almost never far (1/245 in 2025, 3/92 in 2026), so far-ahead == behind-absent. Within the behind-absent group distance is flat (-4.4pp/-1.7pp, ±$16). The raw dep_wall_above_d sign flip between B (+) and B2 (-) is direction-mix composition, resolved by the direction-aware binary.

dep_wall_above_sz / dep_wall_behind_sz: NULL — zero passes. dep_wall_below_sz / dep_wall_ahead_sz: NULL — only $-passes whose wr gaps flip sign across years (e.g. gold q50: +16.9pp 2025 vs -1.0pp 2026); no consistent separation from wall SIZE anywhere.
pattern A slices: untestable — 2026 n=23 total, below the 25-per-cell floor for any split.
